decisions.reason: As a recent launch that builds directly on the firm's established coolant-management business and visible innovation agenda, management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.
This centrifuge fits the firm's core process-media and sustainability-oriented offering, so sunk development effort and strategic fit make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
Because the nozzle range is an extension of the existing portfolio with several models and likely modestly integrated into broader system sales, management would be especially inclined to retain it.

Although only close to the established offer rather than fully central to it, it still supports the firm's automation and material-flow direction, so escalation of commitment points to continued market presence.
This conveyor builds on the firm's established chip-handling business and strengthens a broad systems portfolio, which makes management likely to keep supporting it.

Even if somewhat less central than core coolant products, this launch is adjacent to the firm's existing transport and chip-conveying activities, so a large German engineering firm would usually give it more time before dropping it.
